brief:
An archive of American newspaper excerpts documents how Israel's occupation was reported in the years preceding October 7, 2023, according to Middle East Eye. The historic clippings reveal patterns in how US media covered Palestinian issues and Israeli actions during that period.

The collection provides a record of American press coverage of the occupation prior to the events that would reshape regional reporting. Researchers examining the archive have drawn conclusions about editorial choices and framing in major outlets' treatment of the conflict.

title: Archive shows US media downplayed Israeli occupation before October 2023
